question: Garfiel was able to use his Blessing of the Earth Spirit even on the upper floors of the mansion, but does that mean he’s able to use the blessing when he’s in contact with any part of an object that’s in contact with the ground? In that case, wouldn’t he be able to use the blessing even inside a dragon carriage in motion?
answer: To a certain extent, if it’s something that can be visualized as ‘ground’, it’s possible. of course bare dirt works, but I feel it’s not that difficult to think of buildings on top of the dirt, or even the floor on upper levels as ‘ground’. On the other hand, looking at the floor of a moving vehicle as ground is something that I’d like to be careful of, even as a writer. If it’s a stopped dragon carriage, you might think of it that way, but when you add the condition of it being in motion, it’s perhaps difficult to think of it as ground.
